attempts.summary: Created a logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) on node1, mounted it at /srv/data, grew it from 1GB to 2.2GB while it stayed mounted with contents intact, and confirmed the setup survives a full node restart. Since node1's disk (vda) had no free space or spare block device (fully partitioned into /boot, swap, and /), the PV was backed by a sparse file (/var/lib/lvm-loopfiles/disk0.img, 2.6GB) attached via a fixed loop device (/dev/loop9). Persistence across reboot is handled by a systemd oneshot service (lvm-loop-setup.service) that reattaches the loop device and activates the VG, wired into /etc/fstab via x-systemd.requires.
